title: Report sending volume to Prospectus quota: percent only, no dollars
description:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** Later, coarse

**Goal.** If Ryan confirms sending counts toward quota. Report only (accepted): each host reports items such as `caducus.email.sent` by Account via `POST /v1/quota/accounts/{account}/usage`, batched, retried with the same operation id. A Papyrus site's existing registration needs `quota: true` in Prospectus, so tell that session before merge. No rates in public repos; customers see percent used. Operator, last-resort and consent mail never check quota. Package exposes a hook; Papyrus implements it.

**Acceptance.**
An unknown kind's 422 is visible; no dollar figure or rate anywhere in Git.
